userStories.title: [Regression Test] CLI: spiral trace-dependencies <story-id> - Federated Cross-Project Dependency Res
userStories.description: Write regression test to guard against future breakage of US-675. Story description: New CLI command that recursively resolves and visualizes a story's full dependency chain across federated sub-projects. Detects circular dependencies, displays file paths, and marks sub-project boundaries. Critical for multi-project workflows where US-001 in project-a may depend on PROJECT-B-US-005.
acceptanceCriteria: Regression test covers core observable behaviour of US-675
Test would reliably fail if the US-675 feature were removed or broken
technicalNotes: Run: uv run pytest tests/ -k us_675 -v

userStories.title: Add e2e integration test: full SPIRAL loop with mocked Claude CLI
userStories.description: Create tests/test_spiral_e2e_integration.py with a single test that runs the full SPIRAL phase loop (A→R→T→S→E→M→X→G→I→V→C) using monkeypatched subprocess.run to mock Claude CLI responses. Validates phase execution order and final prd.json state without real API calls.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run pytest tests/test_spiral_e2e_integration.py::test_full_spiral_loop -v completes in <30s with no real API calls
Test asserts all 11 phases executed in correct order by checking a captured phase_log list
Test asserts prd.json story status is 'done' after loop completes

File to create: tests/fixtures/mock_claude_api.py (make_mock_response() returning minimal valid story implementation response)

userStories.title: Add e2e integration tests: story retry escalation and worker crash recovery
userStories.description: Extend tests/test_spiral_e2e_integration.py with two tests: one that mocks a story failure and validates model escalation (haiku→sonnet) written to results.tsv, and one that simulates a worker crash and validates the main loop respawns the worker and completes pending stories.
acceptanceCriteria: uv run pytest tests/test_spiral_e2e_integration.py::test_story_retry_on_failure -v passes and asserts results.tsv contains a sonnet row after haiku failure
uv run pytest tests/test_spiral_e2e_integration.py::test_worker_crash_recovery -v passes and asserts all pending stories reach 'done' status after simulated worker crash

userStories.title: Federated PRD: Add prd.include field for sub-project story composition
userStories.description: Enable prd.json to include stories from sub-projects via a prd.include array. Phase M merges included stories with namespace prefixes (e.g., web:US-100) and validates against circular includes and missing files.
acceptanceCriteria: prd.json accepts top-level prd.include array of file paths without schema validation errors: uv run python lib/prd_schema.py prd.json
load_prd_with_includes() merges stories from a sub-project prd.json with namespace prefix applied to story IDs
Circular include raises an explicit error before any stories are merged
Merged stories have _original_id field set to the pre-namespace story ID
technicalNotes: File to edit: lib/merge_stories.py (add load_prd_with_includes function)
File to edit: prd.schema.json (add prd.include array field definition)

userStories.title: CLI: Add --config flag to spiral.sh for loading custom configuration files
userStories.description: Allow users to specify custom config files via --config flag to override or extend spiral.config.sh, enabling multiple config profiles for different SPIRAL modes (research-only, fast-implement, validation-strict).
acceptanceCriteria: spiral.sh --config /path/to/custom.config.sh loads custom config after base config, custom vars override base
Config validation (lib/validate_config.sh) runs after both files loaded; error if custom config has syntax errors
Config vars from both files are merged; missing vars in custom config fall back to base defaults
technicalNotes: Edit spiral.sh parse_args() to extract --config flag and store path in CUSTOM_CONFIG variable
Modify spiral.sh main() to source CUSTOM_CONFIG after sourcing spiral.config.sh (if provided)
